Q8425.reason: Under the incorporation doctrine, customary international law enters English common law automatically only so far as it is not inconsistent with statute.

Q8427.reason: Acute sinusitis follows viral URI when mucosal edema obstructs the sinus ostia and impairs drainage; ear fluid is a separate Eustachian finding.

Q8428.reason: Fever plus an acute hot swollen monoarthritis is septic arthritis until proven otherwise, so synovial fluid must be obtained before empiric antibiotics.
